verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥ח בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣêḥ bin·ḡî·nōṯ miz·mō·wr šîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·ḥān·nê·nū wî·ḇā·rə·ḵê·nū yā·’êr pā·nāw ’it·tā·nū se·lāh
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Psalm A song May God be gracious to us and bless us and cause His face to shine upon us Selah
verses.literalPt: Compadeça-se Deus de nós, e nos abençoe, e sobre nós faça resplandecer o seu rosto; (Selá)

verses.original: לָדַ֣עַת בָּאָ֣רֶץ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ בְּכָל־ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḏa·‘aṯ bā·’ā·reṣ dar·ke·ḵā bə·ḵāl gō·w·yim yə·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: that Your ways may be known on earth Your salvation among all nations
verses.literalPt: para que seja, na terra, conhecido o seu caminho, entre todas as nações a sua salvação.

verses.original: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.literal: Let the peoples praise You O God let all the peoples praise You
verses.literalPt: Deem-te graças, ó Deus, os povos; deem-te graças os povos todos.

verses.original: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־ תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·mə·ḥū wî·ran·nə·nū lə·’um·mîm kî- ṯiš·pōṭ ‘am·mîm mî·šō·wr ū·lə·’um·mîm bā·’ā·reṣ tan·ḥêm se·lāh
verses.literal: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth Selah
verses.literalPt: Alegrem-se e cantem de júbilo as nações, pois julgarás os povos com equidade e governarás as nações sobre a terra. (Selá)

verses.original: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.literal: Let the peoples praise You O God let all the peoples praise You
verses.literalPt: Deem-te graças, ó Deus, os povos; deem-te graças os povos todos.

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.literal: The earth has yielded its harvest God our God blesses us
verses.literalPt: A terra tem produzido o seu fruto. Deus, o nosso Deus, nos abençoará,

verses.original: יְבָרְכֵ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְיִֽירְא֥וּ אֹ֝ת֗וֹ כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: God blesses us that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him
verses.literalPt: Deus nos abençoará, e todos os confins da terra o temerão.
